mapping.draft_py:
# Goblin Surprise (FDN) -- Choose one --
#  * Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.   (M21 Burn Bright's B4-modify-pt-eot-you)
#  * Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.           (M13 Krenko's Command's B11-create-tokens)
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=Choose(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            options=(
                A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                    'duration': DurationEot(),
                    'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QUnbounded(),
                        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                        filter=FAnd(
                            children=(
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            ),
                        ),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                    'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=0)),
                }),
                A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
                    'count': QConst(value=2),
                    'tokens': TokenSpec(
                        name='Goblin',
                        type_line='Creature — Goblin',
                        types=('Creature',),
                        subtypes=('Goblin',),
                        power=QConst(value=1),
                        toughness=QConst(value=1),
                        keywords=(),
                        abilities=(),
                        colors=('R',),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
]

mapping.notes: Choose(count 1): Burn Bright's +2/+0 until end of turn to creatures you control; Krenko's Command's two 1/1 red Goblins. The probe plays both modes. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: goblin_surprise_pump_locks_in_its_creatures (CR 611.2c).

clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[0]] shows only the pump and [cast modes=[1]] only the tokens: one mode per cast.

clauses.clause: • Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[0]] changes 'you_bear: P/T 2/2 -> 4/2', 'you_giant: 4/4 -> 6/4': power only, my creatures only (the opponent's are untouched); 'after the turn ends: you_bear 4/2 -> 2/2, you_giant 6/4 -> 4/4'. Pack D10_3 (passes): a noncreature artifact with printed 3/3 is not pumped, the opponent's Giant is not either. Pack D10_4 (passes): it is an instant, cast on the opponent's turn.

clauses.clause: • Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[1]] events 'you:Goblin#1 moves new -> battlefield (by card/CREATE_TOKEN)' and 'you:Goblin#2 ...'; changes '+ you:Goblin#1 (battlefield, you, 1/1)', '+ you:Goblin#2 (battlefield, you, 1/1)': two tokens, mine, 1/1, named Goblin. The colour is in the next entry.

No probe line prints a colour (the tree has colors=('R',), identical to the compiler's parse). Packs D10_1 and D10_2 (pass): Devout Decree ('black or red') is offered exactly the two Goblin tokens and not a green Bear, and exiles one: the tokens are colored black-or-red. FDN has no verified card that tells red from black, so 'red' itself rests on the tree.
